main_text.p: bus. Quód fi tum penultima é longa positione fieret brevis, addito u ad o, & ad e, fiet diphthongus: aut vocalis anceps producetur. Denique dativi pluralis penultima nunquam quantitate minor est, quám penultima dativi singularis, ut
2. In ξ, vel ψ, vel praecedente diphthongo in σ desinentia, addito ι, formant dativum pluralem, ut ἅρπαξ rapax, ἅρπαξι: Ἄραψ Arabs, ἄραψι: πλακοῦς placenta, πλακοῦσι: ναῦς navis, ναυσί.

page.notes: Greek passages are reproduced from the scan with approximate accents; the lower lines are partly faded and some accents are doubtful. Final line "tivum" is set at the right and may continue a word.
